Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified Robert Erskine Childers as being born in London, England, while Henry Roth was actually born in Galicia, Ukraine. This mistake was made during step 3 when the WebSurfer provided the incorrect birthplace information for Robert Erskine Childers, leading to the wrong conclusion that he was from England.
